spanish: Hablen a toda congregación de Israel, diciendo: En el diez a este mes, y tomen para ellos varón cordero a casa de padres, cordero a la casa.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3mp is rendered as the 2pl command tomen, so the takers become the addressees of Hablen and the mood becomes imperative.
H7716 is one flock animal, sheep or goat, age open; cordero narrows it to a young sheep.
איש here is the distributive man; varón only marks a male and can be heard as qualifying the animal.

notes: Hablen matches the 2mp piel imperative; para ellos matches the 3mp suffix.
